g.text: Pause instead of kill: idle sandboxes keep memory, node_modules and the dev server. Postgres is the source of truth, so any sandbox can be rebuilt.
cleanup-resources (04:00 UTC): project idle 14 days, or orphan
monitor-sandboxes (every 30 min) alerts when ≥ 3 attempts in the window and ≥ 50 % were REBUILT or FAILED.
Sandboxes are tagged { app: "vibe", database: <hash of DB host> } so a dev database can never delete production's sandboxes.
Mid-run loss: the tool step recreates the sandbox from the DRAFT checkpoint, replays this run's file writes and retries the call once.
